name: Handoff Football
text: When your partner wins a trick you played this card to, gain +40 contract value.

signature.trigger: this card loses a trick your partner wins

archetypes: Kingmaker, Exact Contractor; splash Heart Chorus
decision: Which of your partner's winning tricks to spend this card on: follow under their winner with it rather than winning yourself.
opponent: Visible on trigger; opponents can overtake your partner's card so the trick doesn't go to your team.
aiNote: Play this card when your partner is winning the trick and this card can't beat their card.
rationale: Engraving places it on a face card, so your partner needs an ace or a trump to win over it, and it pays in about a quarter of rounds, about +10 EV, a simple common that rewards letting your partner win.
deviation: Redesigned and renamed from Snaring Lasso, which took the winning card out of the trick and was too complicated for a common.
